labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for new behaviour: Table title accepting types beyond str and Text.

body:
This is a feature request: it asks for the `Table` title to accept more types than `str` and `Text`. Per the project's policy, new features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there.

The grid approach you mention is the existing workaround. See [tables.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) for how tables and grids are composed.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
